error.message: Option "--disclosure-type" contains unknown DART 공시상세유형 detailed code(s): A999, B999. Common codes include A001=사업보고서, A002=반기보고서, A003=분기보고서, F001=감사보고서, and I001=수시공시. If you do not know the code, use the disclosure-types operation or darty disclosure-types --query, and put report-title text in reportName.
error.recoveryHint: Pass known DART 공시상세유형 detailed codes (A001=사업보고서, A002=반기보고서, A003=분기보고서, I001=수시공시, etc.) as an array. If you do not know the code, use the disclosure-types operation or darty disclosure-types --query <term>, and put report-title text in reportName.
